mapper.insert: INSERT INTO manual_review_queue (user_id, content_type, content_id, content, matched_words, categories, source_type, reporter_id, report_reason, target_user_id, status, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{contentType}, #{contentId}, #{content}, #{matchedWords}, #{categories}, #{sourceType}, #{reporterId}, #{reportReason}, #{targetUserId}, #{status}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: SELECT q.*, reporter.nickname AS reporterNickname, reviewer.nickname AS reviewerNickname, target_user.nickname AS targetUserNickname FROM manual_review_queue q LEFT JOIN user reporter ON reporter.user_id = q.reporter_id LEFT JOIN user reviewer ON reviewer.user_id = q.reviewer_id LEFT JOIN user target_user ON target_user.user_id = q.target_user_id WHERE q.status = 0 ORDER BY create_time ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manual_review_queue WHERE status = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE manual_review_queue SET status = #{status}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_remark = #{reviewRemark}, process_action = #{processAction}, review_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT q.*, reporter.nickname AS reporterNickname, reviewer.nickname AS reviewerNickname, target_user.nickname AS targetUserNickname FROM manual_review_queue q LEFT JOIN user reporter ON reporter.user_id = q.reporter_id LEFT JOIN user reviewer ON reviewer.user_id = q.reviewer_id LEFT JOIN user target_user ON target_user.user_id = q.target_user_id WHERE q.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
